prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `matches(pattern, text)` in src/lib.rs for a full-string glob. `*` matches any sequence of characters including an empty one, `?` matches exactly one character, and every other character matches itself. There are no escape characters. The whole text must match the whole pattern. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
